description: Finds the movies of Cavea, now showing or coming soon, by a part of the English name. Give the text in English: Cavea does not match a Georgian name. Returns the code, the name, the status, the duration in minutes, and the age rating of each movie. Data from the web site of Cavea, cavea.ge.

language.description: The language of the names and the texts: ka or en. The default is en.

limit.description: The maximum count of movies, 1 to 100. The default is 20.

query.description: A part of the English name of the movie, 2 to 100 characters.

name: cinema_search_movies

as_of.description: The instant at which the server read the movies, RFC 3339.

movies.description: The movies, in the order of Cavea.

age_rating.description: The age rating of the MPAA, for example PG-13.

code.description: The code of the movie, for example street-fighter.

description.description: A short description of the story.

duration_minutes.description: The duration of the movie, in minutes.

premiere.description: The premiere in Georgia: YYYY-MM-DD, or the year only.

status.description: now_showing or coming_soon. A movie before its premiere date is coming_soon.

url.description: The page of the movie on cavea.ge, where a person buys a ticket.

source.description: The source of the data: Cavea.

stale.description: True when Cavea did not answer and the server returns data it read before.

total.description: The count of movies that matched. More than the count of movies when the limit cut the list.

title: Search the movies of Cavea
